additional_info.subject: Re: ID0474684-DC/Si-D/BE- [MP / PD 170001323] Plug 2 Issue CRM:03289000365
additional_info.body:
Dear
Our technician did an intervention today and fixed the casing of outlet 2.  Additionally, He mentioned to me that, while on site, both outlets were active but stopped charging after 5 seconds. Please reactivate the outlet reactivate the outlet(s) so people can charge again.
How come temporarily disabling an outlet is this difficult? Following your email from yesterday, I confirmed (together with your screenshot) that outlet 2 got disabled. And when checking the logs of the charger in Greenflux now, I see that the outlet was back online just a couple minutes later. Why were the settings changed? And why is it that since the change in settings nobody was able to charge (see chargerlog in attachment).
Met vriendelijke groeten / Cordialement / Kind regards,
Van:
emobility_support.si@siemens.com <emobility_support.si@siemens.com>
